messages.subject: Energy Transition & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Marcus,

Panthera Partners' search work across infrastructure, energy transition and climate investment is strongly aligned with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy and infrastructure growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
